description:
The preregistered target receives an exact rational permanental-rank-deficiency probability, accompanied by an independent importance-sampling cross-check and full provenance.

## Background

Exact compressed-state propagation is the authoritative calculation. The stochastic result provides an independently accumulated uncertainty-bearing check, not a substitute estimate. A failed or unusable stochastic check does not erase the exact value and is preserved as a falsification record.

The result is a derived campaign artifact outside the raw dataset checksum set.

## Success Criteria

- [aspirational] REQ-01: Publishes the exact numerator, denominator, scientific-notation rendering, and logarithmic rendering for $(q,n,k)=(3,1024,3)$.
- [aspirational] REQ-02: Reports the theorem margin $3<0.1\sqrt{1024}=3.2$ and quantifies direct-sampling infeasibility against the exact result and the cited leading-order prediction.
- [aspirational] REQ-03: Publishes the independent stochastic point estimate, interval, variance, sample count, ESS, and usability verdict beside the exact value.
- [aspirational] REQ-04: Preserves disagreement, failed coverage, or inadequate ESS without rerunning, retuning, or replacing the stochastic result.
- [aspirational] REQ-05: Records the final manifest identity, rare-event stream addresses, seeds, git revision, toolchain, executable identity, and exact algorithm version.
- [aspirational] REQ-06: Stores the artifact under the finalized campaign home, outside the raw checksum set, and modifies no previously published raw or derived artifact.
title: Exact permanental-rank probability beyond direct sampling
